title: The village that moved indoors
text: In {{1}} Arctic town of Kiruna, Sweden, the ground itself is a problem: the iron ore mined below the streets {{2}} slowly hollowing them out. Rather {{3}} lose the mine, which employs most of the population, the town is being moved — {{4}} entire buildings — three kilometres east. Residents were compensated for their homes, {{5}} some complained that the money did not cover the loss of a community. The church, {{6}} dates from 1908, was moved on wheels in a single operation. Remarkably, most residents chose to follow, {{7}} a deep attachment to the place. The mine is expected {{8}} operate until 2100, by which time the new Kiruna will have had a century to grow into its own character.
